from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInfo(BaseModel):
    """Basic identification of the company in the current document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the document")

class CashFlowMetric(BaseModel):
    """A specific cash flow line item extracted from the document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company the metric belongs to")
    metric_label: str = Field(description="The specific label of the cash flow line (e.g. 'Net cash provided by operating activities')")
    amount: float = Field(description="The cash flow value (positive for provided/inflow, negative for used/outflow)")
    period: str = Field(description="The period this metric covers (e.g. 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single document for aggregation."""
    company_identifiers: list[CompanyInfo]
    cash_flow_metrics: list[CashFlowMetric]
